notes.title: ROADMAP 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone, just wanted to let you know what will be worked for the upcoming updates:

- A way to update the base into more resistant materials such as Concrete

- Driveable ATV

- New Benchs such as Gun Bench, Oil Extractor, Concrete Mixer and more

- Auto plant watering using a machine

- More Defenses such as Gun Turret

- Other type of zombies

- New animals such as wolf and bear 

- Companion NPC's

- Map improvements with new buildings

- Gun Attachments

- CO-OP Multiplayer

And many more
